notes: Same app 1.11.9 and chart 0.10.0. The two idle limits of the sandbox and the workbench are now carried as quoted strings in values.yaml and added on update where absent: Helm 3.21.1 rendered a plain 1800000 as 1.8e+06 and sandbox-api read it as 1 ms, so every sandbox session and workbench was stopped a minute after creation on such a box.
